part1.title: Nothing to Eat? Send AI a Photo of Your Fridge #shorts
part1.description:
Take one photo of your fridge, send it to an AI chat app and give it limits: 20 minutes, only what's in the photo, no shopping. Then ask for two more options. (It can't smell the milk, though.)
An original animated AI tip by zylo.

Follow for one AI trick a day.

#ai #chatgpt #aitips #cookinghacks #shorts
